nodes.text: Welcome to the artisans' hall. Looms left, carving right, commissions by appointment. I'm Ottilie. Mind the thread tension.

choices.text: Where does mountain cloth come from?

nodes.text: Every one. The Warden asked for 'something dignified' and I delivered dignity with one thread of arrogance woven through the field: silver on silver, visible only when the hall fires gutter. Twenty years and nobody's spotted it. Maren would approve, which is why I'll never tell her.

Lowland cotton up the High Road. Mountain wool off the Greenstair rams. And lately, gloomsilk thread out of the deep. Yes, spider-spun, and no, I will not apologize for it. It takes dye like nothing under the sun and drapes like falling water.
Bolts and thread, mountain grade. If it frays before the year turns, bring it back.
